notes:
App update: cleaner screens and buttons that are always easy to reach

- Home: smaller tiles, so Needs attention shows as soon as the app opens. Pocket bars in colour (today in gold).
- Pocket and Shift: no repeated shortcuts at the top (every page is on Home). Set opening balance is a small Opening link in the cash card.
- Shift: date and 12 / 24 Hour on one line; Submitted, Read only and Page view on one line; Tank stock moved to Home.
- Credit: All / Commercial / Temporary on one row.
- Attendance: duty buttons in neat rows, See month next to each name, Save button right above the tabs.
- ATM Record: month total with Verified and Not verified yet, one card per day, Verified in green.
- Buttons at the bottom never hide under the phone's back button.
- Forms (Compliance, Lube, ATM and others): the Save button stays visible above the keyboard.
